product.tagline: Review and apply XLSX changes in Git.
product.description: SheetProof compares .xlsx workbooks in a Git worktree with validated Git revisions, aligns records by key, and applies approved changes to the editable left workbook.

workbookComparison.title: Workbook-aware comparison
workbookComparison.summary: Compare worksheets, values, formulas, explicit blanks, and types. Display formatting does not determine whether cells are equal.

sideBySideReview.title: Side-by-side review
sideBySideReview.summary: Use synchronized virtual grids, focused navigation, and scrollbar markers for added, deleted, modified, and conflicting data.

rowFilters.title: Current-sheet row filters
rowFilters.summary: Combine added, deleted, modified, and conflict filters without losing the source row being reviewed.

currentSheetFind.title: Find in the current worksheet
currentSheetFind.summary: Search the left and right sides independently with case, Unicode whole-word, and RE2 regular-expression options, including within filtered rows.

controlledMerge.title: Controlled merge and undo
controlledMerge.summary: Write only selected differences to the left; unchanged edits create no unsaved state, while real edits and merges remain undoable.

beforeAfter.title: Hold to compare before and after
beforeAfter.summary: Hold Before/After or Tab in a grid to see the left workbook exactly as it was opened.

localizedExperience.title: English, Chinese, and Japanese
localizedExperience.summary: Use the desktop app, CLI, documentation, website, and localized demonstration workbooks in English, Simplified Chinese, or Japanese.

repositoryMode.title: Local Git repository mode
repositoryMode.summary: Read the real worktree against a validated local or remote-tracking reference without checkout, fetch, or branch switching. A preselected workbook and revision finish loading before the workspace is shown.

safeSave.title: Guarded local saving
safeSave.summary: Detect external changes, write a temporary file in the same directory, reopen it for validation, then replace the original atomically.

configurationReview.title: Review configuration workbooks
configurationReview.summary: Check values, formulas, types, and row changes before a commit or release.

gitChanges.title: Resolve XLSX changes in Git
gitChanges.summary: Compare a worktree with local or remote-tracking references without interrupting the current branch.

selectiveMerge.title: Apply selected corrections
selectiveMerge.summary: Accept only confirmed cells or rows and keep the option to undo before saving.

keyAlignment.alt: SheetProof comparing an English character growth workbook by key
keyAlignment.caption: Key alignment keeps an inserted character beside its neighboring records and leaves 16 actual differences.

physicalRows.alt: SheetProof comparing the same character data by physical row
physicalRows.caption: Without a key column, one inserted record shifts later rows and produces 90 coordinate differences.

focusedDifference.alt: SheetProof focused on character name and balance changes
focusedDifference.caption: Name, HP, and attack changes use the two-sided difference colors; the new character remains separate.

mergeResult.alt: SheetProof after merging one HP value to the left
mergeResult.caption: After the approved HP value is copied left, that cell is equal while every other difference remains.

home.title: SheetProof — Review and apply XLSX changes in Git
home.description: Compare .xlsx workbooks with Git revisions, align records by key, and apply approved cells or rows locally.

features.title: Features
features.description: Workbook-aware Git comparison, key alignment, selective application, undo, and safe local saving.

guide.title: Guide
guide.description: Open files or repositories, review differences, configure UGit, and save SheetProof results safely.

download.title: Download
download.description: Download the unsigned SheetProof preview for Windows amd64 or macOS universal and verify SHA-256.
